name: GitHub Copilot
description: Installs the GitHub Copilot CLI and configures GitHub Copilot VS Code extensions.

instructionFilePath.description: Path to the central instruction file, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/AGENTS.md') to enable instruction symlinking.

instructionsPath.description: Path to the source directory of Markdown instructions, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Each file is linked into .github/instructions with a .instructions.md suffix.

skillsPath.description: Path to the source skills directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). When configured, it is linked to .agents/skills.
